limitations: The theorem applies to finite simple connected graphs and does not classify the minimum independent dominating sets. The proof uses Theorem 2.12 of arXiv:2609.16357v1. The elementary independence-number lemma may be known separately; originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge for the higher-iterate identity and its consequences. Very recent or not-yet-indexed parallel work may exist. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
